description: Convert any date to its ISO week date (YYYY-Www-D) and back — find the Monday of any ISO week.

faqs.a: ISO 8601 defines week 1 as the week containing the first Thursday of the year (equivalently, the week with January 4th). Weeks start on Monday.
Yes — most years have 52 ISO weeks, but years starting on Thursday (or leap years starting on Wednesday) have 53.
Enter the ISO year, week number and day (1=Monday … 7=Sunday) and the exact calendar date is computed.
faqs.q: How does the reverse conversion work?

howto: To convert forward: pick any calendar date.
To convert back: enter ISO year, week and day.
title: ISO Week Date Converter
